_childDocuments_.review: Most noble leader, illustrious tribunes, generals, most courageous fellow soldiers and all loyal honest citizens! You know well that the hour has come: the enemy of our faith wishes to oppress us even more closely by sea and land with all his engines and skill to attack us with the entire strength of this siege force, as a snake about to spew its venom; he is in a hurry to devour us, like a savage lion. For this reason I am imploring you to fight like men with brave souls, as you have done from the beginning up to this day, against the enemy of our faith. I hand over to you my glorious, famous, respected, noble city, the shining Queen of Cities, our homeland. You know well, my brothers, that we have four obligations in common, which force us to prefer death over survival: first our faith and piety; second our homeland; third, the emperor anointed by the Lord, and fourth; our relatives and friends.Well, my brothers, if we must fight for one of these obligations, we will be even more liable under the command strength of all four; as you can clearly understand. If God grants victory to the impious because of my own sins, we will endanger our lives for our holy faith, which Christ gave us with his own blood. This is most important of all. Even if one gains the entire world but loses his soul in the process, what will be the benefit! Second, we will be deprived of such famous homeland and of our liberty. Third, our empire, renowned in the past but presently humbled, low and exhausted, will be ruled by a tyrant and an impious man. Fourth, we will be separated from our dearest children, wives and relatives.This wretch of a Sultan has besieged our city up to now for fifty seven days with all his engines and strength; he has relaxed the blockade neither day nor night, but, by the grace of Christ, our Lord, who sees all things, the enemy has often been repelled, up to now, from our walls with shame and dishonour. Yet now too, my brothers, feel no cowardice, even if small parts of our fortifications have collapsed from the explosions and engine missiles, as you can see, we made all possible, necessary repairs. We are placing all hope in the irresistible glory of God. Some have faith in armament, others in cavalry, might and numbers but we believe in the name of our Lord, our God and Saviour, and second, in our arms and strength granted to us by divine power.I know the countless hordes of the impious will advance against us, according to their custom, violently, confidently and with great courage and force in order to overwhelm and wear out our few defenders with hardship. They attempt to frighten us with loud yells and innumerable battle cries. But you are all familiar with their chattering and I need say no more about it. For a long time they will continue so and will also release over us countless rocks, all sorts of arrows and missiles, like the sand of the sea. But I hope that such things will not harm us; I see, greatly rejoice, and nourish with hopes in my mind that even if we are few, you are all experienced and seasoned warriors – courageous, brave, and well prepared. Protect your heads with shields in combat and battle. Keep your right hand, armed with the sword, extended in front of you at all times. Your helmets, breastplates and suits of armour are fully sufficient together with your other weapons and will prove very effective in battle. Our enemies have none and use no such weapons. You are protected inside the walls, while they will advance without cover and with toil.For these reasons, my fellow soldiers, prepare yourselves, be firm, and remain valiant, for the pity of God. Take your example from the few elephants of the Carthaginians and how they dispersed the numerous cavalry of the Romans with their noise and appearance. If one dumb beast put another to flight, we, the masters of horses and animals, can surely even do better against our advancing enemies, since they are dumb animals, worse even than pigs. Present your shield, swords, arrows, and spears to them, imagining that you are a hunting party after wild boars, so that the impious may learn that they are dealing not with dumb animals but with their lords and masters, the descendants of the Greeks and the Romans.You are well aware that this irreligious Sultan, the enemy of our holy faith, violated for no good reason the peace treaty we had with him and disregarded his numerous oaths without a second thought. Suddenly, he appeared and built his castle in the straights of Asomatosso so he might be able to inflict daily harm on us. Then he put our farms, gardens, parks, and houses to the torch, while he killed and enslaved as many of our Christian brothers as he found; he broke the treaty of friendship. He befriended the inhabitants of Galata, the wretches rejoice over this, as they are unaware of the parable of the farmer’s son who was roasting snails and said, ‘Oh stupid creature,’ etc.Well my brothers, since he started the siege and the blockade, every day he opens his fathomless mouth and is seeking an opportunity to devour us and this city, which thrice-blessed Constantine the Great founded and dedicated to the all holy most chaste Mother of God, our lady, Mary the eternal virgin. She became the Queen of Cities, the shield and aid of our homeland, the shelter of Christians, the hope and joy of all wishes to destroy this city, which was once proud and blooming like a rose of the field.I can tell you that this city mastered the entire universe; She placed beneath her feet Pontus, Armenia, Paphlagonia, The Amazonian lands, Cappadocia, Galatia, Media, Georgian Colchis, Bosphoros, Albania, Syria, Cilicia, Mesopotamia, Phoenicia, Palestine, Arabia, Judea, Bactria, Scythia, Macedonia, Thessaly, Boeotia, Locris, Aetolia, Arcarnania, Achaea, the Peloponnese, Epirus, Illyria, Lykhnites, the Adriatic, Italy, Tuscany, the Celts, and Galatian Celts, Spain up to Cadiz, Libya, Mauritania, Ethiopia, Beledes, Scude, Numidia, Africa and Egypt.Now he wants to enslave her and throw the yoke upon the Mistress of Cities, our holy churches, where the Holy Trinity was worshiped, where the Holy Spirit was glorified in hymns, where angels were heard praising in chant the deity of and the incarnation of God’s word, he wants to turn into shrines of his blasphemy, shrines of the mad and false Prophet, Mohammed, as well as into stables for his horses and camels.Consider then, my brothers and comrades in arms, how the commemoration of our death, our memory, fame and freedom can be rendered eternal.”

_childDocuments_.review: SNK seems to have ironed out most of the matchmaking problems with this game so I've changed this review to a recommendation. I think the fix might be too little too late for a lot of people, including me, but this was the sole reason I could not recommend this game before, and it seems to be mostly fixed. If you're interested in the KOF series or modern fighting games in general, this game is a good place to start=== OLD REVIEW ===this game is amazing and is some of the most fun I've ever had playing a fighting game, the characters are expressive, the mechanics are sick, the netcode is great. Outside of a lack of single player content (which is an issue in most fighting games tbf) there isnt anything blatantly wrong with the game itselfso it's such a shame that the matchmaking is practically non-existentI know people are tired of hearing this but it needs to be said for as long as its an issue. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise just because it may work for them: this game's matchmaking is either dysfunctional, misconfigured on the back-end, or both. The fact that a game that came out in 2022 has a matchmaking system far worse than some from 2012 is crazy, and the fact that is hasn't been addressed for almost a whole year now outside of some vague posts, a survey, and a patch that pretty much just put a bandaid on a broken bone is crazier.From my perspective, I was super excited before this game because I wanted to get back into KOF (my last kof game before this was 2002UM) and this game released the day before my birthday, so I had an excuse to get it full price. In the first two months it worked mostly fine. I was finding matches regularly and had tons of fun, then one day it just suddenly stopped. I sat anywhere from 30 minutes to an hour in training standby to wait for a match sometimes for it to either never come. Suddenly I felt as if i wasted 80$CDN. I had friends to play with outside of that, but like me they all got demotivated from this game because they were having the exact same problems. Player numbers are not the issue. I regularly play Rivals of Aether, which was made by a much smaller indie team and has a smaller active playerbase, yet in that game 10 minutes is the longest I've ever had to wait for a match. Common wait times are between 10 **seconds** and 3 minutesAnd no I'm not using lobbies or discord servers. In my experience with this game and other fighting games, so many matches from those tend to be laggy lmaoThis is the first real steam review I'm writing because this game is straight up a huge disappointment to me. Solely on gameplay, this is one of my favourite fighting games ever, and that's saying a lot. Yet this one issue is preventing me and hundreds more from using what should be a main-priority feature to play the game online. Unless you plan to take the game seriously as a competitive player or you're fine with dealing with lobbies and matchmaking discord servers, don't buy this at full price

_childDocuments_.review: KOF XV is what XIV should've been. Better graphics, mechanics and shatter strike brings a offensive/defensive idea into the mix. There's something missing from this KOF though and it's hard for me to pinpoint the exact area or reason. For example, the menus are extremely simple, but the game takes a while to load certain assets. Some options are curiously missing, such as changing the order of the team without going to character selection screen.It's a weird KOF then. It's definitely a better product than XIV and I still recommend it. However, it is far from the best KOF or a complete fighting game package. And that's might be the worst problem in the end: it's just a good KOF but nothing more.In a genre with heavy hitters like Guilty Gear Strive, Tekken 7 or the upcoming RIOT fighting game, KOF needs to reinvent itself to be a game for more than just the legacy players. I'm here waiting for better changes next week.

_childDocuments_.review: King of Fighters 15 is basically a couple of tweaks and a new coat of paint on the previous installment. The new Shatter Strike adds a tool universal to every character and, with the standardizing of climax inputs across the board, is a needed move in the direction of accessibility for a series that requires you to learn three characters from the get-go. The most exciting change, however, is the unchaining of EX moves from the limits of Max Mode. That adds so many new options, which will be obvious to many long time KoF players as, again, there hasn't been any seismic changes between entries. Series veterans will also recognize more old faces from previous games without many brand new ones to offset that familiarity, which is surprisingly explained by the storyline as it picks up where KoF 14 left off. The advancing story of the titular tournament is told as it always is, in official team endings and special character interactions. But now those Story mode runs can also net you tracks from previous games to customize the game's soundtrack. The new Boss mode challenge, showing up next to the returning Trial mode, adds a little extra flavor to the offline component without leaning even heavier on the same arcade experience or hours spent alone in Training mode. And that's an awful good thing to have because matchmaking is a bit of a mess right now. I was able to get matches, causal or ranked, every couple of minutes or so, but not at the rate I would expect from an established series at launch. Judging from the game's discussions, even that rate makes me one of the lucky ones. But the online experience is likely to get to a better place over time and, with new teams planned to release every couple of months, the game isn't exactly in danger of drying up completely before getting that chance.

_childDocuments_.review: XIV had some issues, but they were just out of bankruptcy so i gave them the benefit of the doubt. It was still a very fun game to play despite the lacking graphics and horrendous online.XV at the start was also very fun; the game looks good, plays good, has rollback and brought back some fan favorites. However, it's impossible to find anyone to play nowadays because the matchmaking is STILL broken. "Then play by yourself?" Too bad, there's next to zero single player content. Hell, they even removed basic modes like Survival and Time Attack from XIV! -Combo Trials are still very short and easy, majority of them follow the same pattern of "Normal > Command Normal > MAX > Normal > Command Normal > EX Special > 1 Bar Super > 2 Bar Super > Climax". They teach you next to nothing about  basic combo routes like most other fighting games. -There's also Boss Challenge with Omega Rugal, sure, but this "CPU from hell" turned out to be a major jobber. Nothing like his prime days from 94, 98, CvS2 etc. In my opinion it should be easy enough to add more bosses to this mode from the existing roster like Re Verse, Otoma=Raga, Nightmare Geese, Billy, Yamazaki, Awakened Orochi Team, Dark Ash etc. and up the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ factor. I want the computer to read all my inputs. I want them all to have spammable projectiles or moves that come out in just 1 frame. I want to be in pain because i am a masochist.Fun game but sadly i can't recommend it in its current state. You can't play online, and if you wanna play offline your only options are playing Arcade over and over or locally with your friends.

_childDocuments_.review: KoF XV is a marked improvement over its predecessor in pretty much all aspects. The game, for one thing, looks far better. The graphics are clean, expressive, and very colorful. The simplicity in certain graphical elements reminds me of some sixth gen console games, This is a good thing; the game remains consistently clear and readable, even when the action is intense.Online play is also vastly improved, featuring solid rollback netcode implementation along with a variety of essential modes such as good lobbies and online training.Gameplay-wise, it stays similar to XIV, only making minor changes to the formula. This means it also remains a great game to get into for beginners to the series. In fact, given the other improvements mentioned, this is probably the best starting point for newcomers.I highly recommend this game overall. Excellent stuff.

_childDocuments_.review: I cannot recommend this game until they fix matchmaking. Sure, it has Rollback netcode, which is the new standard, but it's not much good when you can't even find a match online in the first place. That aside, I will not say it's a totally bad game, KoF has plenty of cool characters that are fun to play and this is no different, the DLC characters look sweet, the soundtrack to this game is for the most part awesome, there's plenty of characters with neat and sometimes distinct playstyles although the roster is also loaded with a bunch of shoto clones, moreso than Street Fighter, but, without matchmaking, the singleplayer content to this game is pretty barebones, the menu and HUD are bland and kind of ugly, particularly in the choice of color. Arcade mode isn't even a classic arcade mode where you just fight character after character, it's a story mode that's a bit of a drag and ends with a cheap and annoying boss fight. Sure the game has a versus mode as well, but apart from that there's not much going for the game in terms of offline content, especially when, when it comes to the fighting mechanics, yeah, plenty of characters have fun movesets some of them unique and enjoyable, but the "rush combo" mechanic just ruins the game for me, you suddenly have to be very precarious which buttons you press while going at your opponent because hitting the wrong normal button in a combo will spend your meter on a super combo or EX super you didn't even want to do. Seriously, if I want to use my normals, let me use my normals and the exact normals that I want, if I want to use my supers or do one of the super combos, then I'll memorize the input so I can quickly do it. I don't want easy bake normal/super combos, I want to learn good combos with normals and normals in conjunction with specials and probably topped off with a super or EX at my choosing, I will change my review when they fix just those two things: Fix matchmaking, and remove the rush combo mechanic, and I will have a much better time with this game, until then, I spent $44.99 on this on sale and I still feel cheated. You'd be better off playing the classic KoFs until then, however way you please, it's way cheaper anyway.

_childDocuments_.review: I don't often post reviews these days, but being an avid fighting game enthusiast, I need to do my part. Scroll for the short version below!In many ways, King of Fighters is a true love-letter to KOF fans of both old and new. While it's definitely not a perfect fighting game, due to being quite difficult to grasp and due to lacking offline modes..It's improved in almost all aspects in comparison to its predecessor (KOFXIV). Better visuals, better online, better performance. It's all there. SNK has truly learned from the relative failure which was KOFXIV.I want to talk about the offline content a bit. We are missing basic stuff like Survival and Time Attack modes, but it can all be forgiven considering the online experience is simply superb this time around. Story of KOFXV is nothing to write home about, it's not innovative, it's not exactly exciting either. But if you care even a bit about the characters, or their history, it will put a smile on your face. I found it to be a very wholesome experience, and there's so much attention to detail in terms of the LONG history of King of Fighters franchise and even the other franchises such as Art of Fighting and Fatal Fury. Lot of cameos, lot of inside jokes and stuff like that. I hope it will give people incentive to check out the older titles, to understand who these people are and what they are talking and joking about.I also want to give a shoutout for SNK. Most fighting games nowadays lack a real, classic 'Arcade' mode, with character endings by the end of each playthrough. The 'wholesome' story truly shines in each of those character endings that are stylized to feel like those old Arcade playthroughs.There's a lot of characters to  try out, each feeling distinct and refreshing to play. I'm personally not the biggest fan of the newcomers to this title, but I'm glad to see some of the newcomers from KOFXIV to be inserted into this game as well, (such as Antonov and Kukri).It's also quite charming to be able to view all the cutscenes and unlocked endings in the gallery section. And the Jukebox function is a great function to give players incentive to keep playing, as you unlock tons of songs from not only previous KOF games to play in your matches. As a final note, I want to express my excitement in regards to the future of KOFXV, with all the DLC that is to come, starting with Garou: Mark of the Wolf pack coming out next month! Let's enjoy the game. Burn to fight!TLDRPros: Graphics+, Character Roster+, Online+, Unlockables+, Cutscenes+, Performance+Cons: Lacking offline modes-, Not the most accessible fighting game-, bland story-Overall, I give it a solid 8,5 / 10

_childDocuments_.review: A solid entry in the KOF franchise.Most of the particle effects are terrible, but for the most part the graphics and presentation don't offend my eyes like XIV did. It definitely looks better in motion.XV lowers the skill floor (simplifying some inputs, some universal inputs, input buffer larger) while the ceiling remains as high as previous entries. (characters retain their depth of moves). Legacy skill will carry over, so you can easily stay on 98/02 if you would prefer to get XV on a discount.The music is great, but if for whatever reason you don't like it XV has soundtracks from previous games via unlocks.Rollback netcode has been great. Playing against high ping people is doable. Matchmaking needs to be patched however, as there can be times when you will not be able to connect to any opponent.XV online does suffer from the same problem as GG Strive in that it does not have an online quality check for PC. So players with PCs that can't handle the game are allowed to play online, resulting in underwater slowdown matches. What both Strive and XV really need is a wifi connection indicator like Tekken 7 and DOA6 so you can properly currate the quality of matches you play. The connection quality filter on matchmaking is not very accurate.PC XV looks to be the best version of the game as the Playstation counterparts suffer from greater input lag.Honestly, the only off putting thing about XV is the MSRP. It's a lot to ask for, but I think people will get enough replay out of it for a long time.

Inheriting the series' traditional 3-on-3 team battle, KOF XV also features a new system. Enjoy an unprecedented sense of speed and freshness!

- KOF is fully packed with content to enjoy
